title: Covered Calls
description: Selling call options against shares you already own to generate income.
educationalHint: Ideal for generating cash flow on stocks you are willing to sell if called away.

title: Cash-Secured Puts
description: Selling put options while setting aside cash to purchase the stock if assigned.
educationalHint: Allows entering quality stocks at a discount while collecting premium.

title: The Wheel Strategy
description: Systematically selling Cash-Secured Puts until assigned, then selling Covered Calls until called away.
educationalHint: A popular income strategy requiring patience and willingness to own the underlying stock.

title: Buy & Hold Equities / ETFs
description: Purchasing quality stocks or ETFs for long-term appreciation and dividends.
educationalHint: Forms the stable equity core of an options income portfolio.

title: Custom / Hybrid Strategy
description: A personal options setup or strategy overlay (e.g., Deep ITM covered calls, Buy/Write/Decide).
educationalHint: Detail your specific entry/exit rules and strategy overlay in the free-text description box.
